lines.say: You have 20 Claude Code tabs open and can't track which one does what.
And on reboot, you lose everything.
Paperclip is open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents.
If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company.
First you define the goal, then you hire the team: a CEO, a CTO, engineers, designers and marketers.
Any bot from any provider can join, because if it can receive a heartbeat, it's hired.
Then you review the strategy, set budgets, hit go and monitor everything from the dashboard.
Atomic task checkout gives every task a single assignee, so competing runs can't claim the same work.
The team has merged over 2,700 pull requests, and the repo has 99088 stars.
With Node.js 24.11 or newer installed, run npx paperclipai onboard.
It is self-hosted, and no Paperclip account is required.
Send this to someone with too many agent tabs open.
That was Paperclip, open source under MIT.
